invariants.evidence: Thermal sidecar composes with the one SWAP kernel; no alternate kernel.
Contract is runtime/coupler data only; no kernel file I/O.
Water mass, thermal provenance, configuration and result roles remain separate.
No thermal provenance is added to persistent per-column continuation state.
Candidate thermal binding is worker/runtime scratch or candidate-scoped metadata.
Sidecar is sparse and optional rather than object-heavy per logical column.
Thermal binding follows existing candidate/prepared commit-abort lifecycle; rejects publish nothing.
Retry/corrector must rebind to the exact new candidate; stale provenance cannot be reused.
Thermal request uses generic sample [t0,t1] and current-reference t1, no calendar assumption.
No fixed coupling-window duration is introduced.
Binding is designed directly against groundwater candidate and transactional coupling authorities.
Existing q_groundwater=-q_swap contract remains authoritative and byte-unchanged.
Thermal sidecar owns no water amount and cannot alter the mass ledger.
No change to interface sensitivity authority or output.
No additional SWAP solve is permitted for donor-temperature reconstruction.
Sparse opt-in thermal requests remain suitable for large MultiSWAP batches.
Tile fractions and MODFLOW-cell composition remain runtime/coupler responsibilities.
Deep-vadose may be an external provider but remains a separate component outside SWAP.
Contract forbids loss/double count of stored water or energy during route changes.
Binding consumes public accepted-route/coupling contracts, not a particular Richards implementation.
No duplicated SWAP process physics or legacy globals are introduced.
No HeadCalc or solver-internal arrays enter the thermal provider seam.
Physical donor provenance is not encoded as solver policy.
Missing/stale thermal provenance fails closed for energy without unbounded recomputation.
Reference hydrology and thermal solution paths remain unchanged.
Future implementation is required to diagnose missing/stale/mismatched external donor provenance.
Thermal provider cost/state is incurred only for requested inward-energy routes.
Runtime/coupler maps direct groundwater, transfer zone and other external sources.
No midnight, day-length, file-format or direct-MODFLOW assumption is introduced.
This JSON explicitly reconciles EB-I16 against invariants 1 through 30.
